newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank is expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Wednesday through overnight system repurchase agreements, economists said.
"We're expecting an overnight system RP today," said an economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International expect the Fed to inject reserves through system RPs on Wednesday, the last day of the current two-week reserve maintanence period.
Analysts did not discount the possibility of another coupon pass on Wednesday after the Fed bought coupons on Tuesday from May 15, 2002 to February 15, 2007.
At 0925 EST/1425 GMT, the federal funds were traded at 5-7/16 percent, well above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
